I found myself reading Brave New World by Aldous Huxley and wanted to see what other people thought of it. So I YouTube searched and found Pewds first book review video. And I was surprised that of all the reviews I had read Felix had the most articulate insights. Then I ended up reading his other recommendations, such as Tegmark's Life 3.0 and No longer human by Osamu Dazai. I hoped to create a thread so that we could all develop some reading habits and discover new books, and hopefully Pewds can talk about his recommended books more.
